candidate_dataset_comparison.name: United Kingdom Contracts Finder OCDS CSV
candidate_dataset_comparison.fit: Selected: rich procurement notice fields map naturally to the existing sales_order_fulfillment target contract, with more than eight target-bearing fields and multiple natural multi-target cases.

candidate_dataset_comparison.name: IDB Project procurement bidding notices and contract awards dataset
candidate_dataset_comparison.fit: Considered but not selected for this step: useful award/procurement data, but less directly aligned to the sales-order fulfillment target fields without pulling in a broader procurement-specific target contract.

sampling.method: Keep the first 24 rows from the 2026 main.csv member where the 13 positive-bearing required fields are non-empty, then project the selected public source columns without renaming them.
sampling.source_value_normalization: values are written as read from the CSV export, except UTF-8 output encoding, CSV escaping, and removal of physical line-end trailing spaces required by the repository whitespace gate
sampling.field_name_normalization: none; selected source column names are copied from the public CSV header
sampling.sensitive_column_handling: Only main.csv notice-level fields are used. Parties/contact fields containing names, emails, telephone numbers, and street addresses are not copied into this fixture.
